<cite ref="Bava Batra 165b">B. Bath. 165ᵇ</cite>, a. fr. <he>במוֹתַב תלתא</he> in a session of three judges.
Koh. R. to III, 6 [read:] יהב להון מוֹתְבֵיהוֹן וכ׳ he assigned to them their place in a dark compartment of the ship; a. fr.—בית מ׳ court, school.

<cite ref="Bekhorot 5b:3">Bekh. 5ᵇ</cite> <he>בבית מ׳ רבה</he> in the Great College; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 224:2">Yalk. Ex. 224</cite> <cite ref="M00695"><he>מוֹתְבָה</he></cite>.—Pl. <cite ref="M00703"><he>מוֹתְבִין</he></cite>, constr. <he>מוֹתְבֵי</he>.
